questions.stem_text:
In a laboratory procedure, a student observes different sizes of soil particles. Which
tool is best for the investigation?

options.A: a hand lens with 1 X magnification
options.C: a light microscope with 100 X magnification
options.D: a dissecting microscope with 4 X magnification

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a dissecting microscope with 4 X magnification

questions.stem_text: What process causes igneous rock to transform into metamorphic rock?

options.D: exposure to heat and high pressure

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - exposure to heat and high pressure

questions.stem_text:
How many basic units of information in a DNA molecule are required to encode a single
amino acid?

When a button is pushed on a battery-operated clock, the time display is illuminated. What
process has taken place?

options.A: Pressure has been converted to light.
options.B: Force has been converted to light.
options.C: Closing an electric circuit has produced light.
options.D: Opening an electric circuit has produced light.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Closing an electric circuit has produced light.

questions.stem_text:
A mouse is placed at one end of a cardboard maze that has a piece of cheese at the other
end. The mouse smells the cheese and learns how to find it. The mouse is using an

options.A: acquired trait to gain an inherited trait.
options.B: inherited trait to gain an acquired trait.
options.C: acquired trait to gain another acquired trait.
options.D: inherited trait to gain another inherited trait.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - inherited trait to gain an acquired trait.
